name: Chokotto! Fandisc
original_name: ちょこっと！ファンディスク
source:
Fandisc contains is a bonus story for heroine Yukako from Natsumegu and also short episodes with heroines of Nagisa no and Reconquista.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/09/vn-of-month-september-2008-sumaga.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
本Fan Disc收录《夏めぐ》的女主人公由佳子后日谈，以及《渚の》和《Reconquista》女主人公们的短篇故事。
